items.name: Milan Cube Day 2017

venue.name: [Ludoteca "La casa dei giochi"](http://www.uniesm.it/)
venue.details: Main room of the building on the right. Press any key on the interphone to open the gate.

items.information: There is a limit of 80 competitors. At a certain point we'll send an email to confirm your participation; competitors who don't confirm within the date specified in that email will be deleted. Remember to check your inbox 1-2 weeks before the competiton. [![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png) Clicka qui per il sito web in italiano](http://cubingitaly.org/mcd17)

items.name: Slovakian Cube Day 2017

venue.name: [Slovak University of Technology](http://www.inqb.sk/)
venue.details: On the first floor in the back, follow the signs.

items.information: Competitors limit is 55 people. Entry fee is 10 EUR/person for competitors and 2 EUR for spectators. For more information, check out the tabs!

items.name: Slow N Steady Spring 2017

venue.name: Adele H. Stamp Student Union
venue.address: 3100 Adele H. Stamp Student Union, College Park, MD 20742

items.information: Registration cost is $15 online. Registration at the door will not be allowed. Free for UMD students, faculty, staff, and alumni. There is a 250 person competitor limit.
